attr.title: Mega Man X Recompiled
attr.desc: Native Mega Man X SNES recompilation for RG35XX-H / KNULLI using SDL2 OpenGL ES 2.
attr.inst: This auto-install package includes the X1, X2 and X3 ROM files supplied to the private build workflow. X1 is used as the main game; X2 and X3 are staged as donor ROMs and preselected for the corresponding Mods resources.
